state:
Goal `core-request-mount-and-1-more` is reached: `Core\Request\Mount` and `Core\Request\Part` both pass `bun nv proofs --verify --group`, with nothing owed.
Every `Core\Request\Part` member has its `about.md`, three examples, one attack, one bench and a perf record on disk.
`filename`'s examples and attack carry an `nvs.toml` granting `fs` read and write, the same as `saveTo`'s.
`bun nv verify --doc`, `bun nv owners --closes` and `bun nv playbook --closes` are all green for this goal.
A proof program that needs a request does not run under `bun nv try`: `bun nv proofs --run --id '<member>' --show` runs one member's proofs and prints their output.
`bun nv proofs --record-perf` reads only the last `--id` it is given, so each member is recorded with its own call.
